title: Eventions IPO Details
intro:
Eventions IPO is a book build issue of ₹38.12 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 32.30 lakh shares of ₹38.12 crore.

Eventions IPO opens for subscription on Sep 30, 2026 and closes on Oct 5, 2026. The allotment for the Eventions IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 6, 2026. Eventions IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 8, 2026.

Eventions IPO is set issue price band at ₹112 to ₹118 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,83,200 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹4,24,800.

Corporate Professionals Capital Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Mudra RTA Ventures Private Limited is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Aftertrade Broking Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Eventions IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in December 2020, Eventions Limited is engaged in the Meetings, Incentives, Conferences and Exhibitions (“MICE”) and event management segment. The Company provides services for planning, coordination and execution of corporate events, conferences and related activities, primarily for corporate and institutional clients.The Company offers a range of services including MICE services, corporate events, conferences, incentive travel programs, virtual events, Free Independent Travel (“FIT”) services, and brand and marketing activations. Its services cover venue coordination, travel and accommodation arrangements, logistics management and on-site event execution. The Company primarily operates through a B2B model and also provides execution support to other event management companies for large-scale or multi-location assignments.

The Company follows an asset-light business model and coordinates with hospitality providers, destination management companies, logistics partners and event production vendors to execute assignments across different locations. It has executed events across India and international destinations in Europe, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific, including Spain, France, the Netherlands, Switzerland, Hungary, the UAE, Azerbaijan, Singapore and Indonesia. During the Financial Years 2026, 2025 and 2024, the Company executed 107 successful events with individual billing value exceeding ₹50 lakh and served more than 50 corporate clients.

The Company’s MICE segment contributed 91.29%, 91.77% and 87.39% of its revenue from operations in Financial Years 2026, 2025 and 2024, respectively. Its client base includes organisations from sectors such as banking, insurance, FMCG and event management. The Company has also received industry recognition, including the “India’s Leading MICE & Event Brand of the Year” award for 2024–25 and a Certificate of Appreciation from TBO.com. Its subsidiary, Gantu Online Private Limited, focuses on B2C travel and customised travel experiences.
As on March 31, 2026, the Company had a total workforce of 35 employees across accounts and finance, HR and administration, client servicing, creative, events operations and MICE operations.
strengths: Event execution capabilities across multiple geographies.
Integrated service model for MICE and corporate events.
Established corporate client relationships and repeat engagements.

faqs.question: How to apply in Eventions IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Eventions IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Eventions IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Eventions IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Eventions IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Eventions IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Eventions IPO opens on Wed, Sep 30, 2026 and closes on Mon, Oct 5, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Eventions IPO?
faqs.answer: Eventions IPO lot size is 1200 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,83,200 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Eventions IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Eventions IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Eventions IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Eventions IPO will be done on Tuesday, October 6, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Wed, Oct 7, 2026 . Check the Eventions IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Eventions IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Eventions IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Thu, Oct 8, 2026 .
